text:
maya-sales: FYI sharing POC plan for AcmeHealth microburst test. Need alignment on runbook and pricing ask.
jordan-se: Draft below — 3 phases: smoke, sustained, microburst spike sim. Smoke = quick health checks (10k qps, 60s). Sustained = target throughput for 10m. Microburst = 25k qps for 30s to simulate sudden traffic spike.
liam-ae: Customer asked about burst SLA and an overage cap if they exceed reserved throughput. Also wants per-hour billing example.
sam-engineer: For accurate characterization we'll run on Dedicated pool with autoscale disabled for microburst. That shows raw saturation and queueing.
jordan-se: Load command we used for smoke (k6):
```
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 60s script_smoke.js --rps 10000```
jordan-se: For microburst we used a phased ramp then hold:
```
k6 run --vus 2500 --duration 30s script_burst.js --rps 25000```
jordan-se: Expected baseline numbers on m60x4: p50 ~45ms, p95 ~180ms, p99 ~420ms. We'll collect GPU util, server CPU, and queue depth traces.
loadbot: Test job queued: id=89321, scheduled 15:00 PT. Will post artifacts when done.
maya-sales: Also flagged security Q from AcmeHealth: SOC2 fields, KMS key provenance, and VPC peering requirements.
sam-engineer: KMS + VPC peering supported on Dedicated; we'll provide config template. Potential blocker: customer specifically requires HSM-backed key attestations.
liam-ae: Do we treat HSM integration as PS? They asked for an estimate and timeline.
jordan-se: Recommend PS engagement for HSM setup and attestation — estimate 1 week onsite/config + validation. Ballpark $25k one-time.
maya-sales: They also want a failover/runbook for multi-region fallback. Can we present warm-standby approach?
sam-engineer: Yes — model mirroring + async replication for cache warmup. Note: first few requests post-failover will see higher latencies due to KV cache cold start (~2min warmup). We'll document mitigation steps.
loadbot: Test complete. Summary (artifacts: s3://redwood-poc/89321): smoke OK. Sustained 8k qps: p99=350ms. Microburst 25k qps for 30s: queueing observed, tail p99=1.8s, 0.6% drop rate (timeouts).
jordan-se: Attached flamegraphs and server metrics. Primary limiter was CPU on the TPU hosts and batching window hitting max. Autoscaler policy thresholds caused delayed scale decisions.
maya-sales: I'll forward results + pricing options to AcmeHealth: (1) burst credits model, (2) increase reserved capacity, (3) PS for tuning/HSM. Need a short note on cost delta and recommended config.
liam-ae: Drafting cost note: recommend 2x reserved for baseline headroom + daily burst credits (2h/day). Quick calc => estimated delta $6k/month vs current quote. Will attach spreadsheet.
sam-engineer: For immediate mitigation, tune KV cache TTL and bump batching window to 10ms to improve throughput under spikes. Re-run microburst after tuning?
jordan-se: Re-run scheduled in 45m with batching+cache TTL changes. Will publish updated summary.
loadbot: Re-run done (job=89322). New summary: microburst p99 improved to 560ms, drop rate 0.02%. CPU peaks reduced by 35%. Artifacts at s3://redwood-poc/89322.
maya-sales: Great — I'll present these numbers on the customer call tomorrow 11am PT. I'll cover runbook, costs, and security notes. :thumbsup:
liam-ae: I'll join the call. Can someone pull PS T&Cs for the HSM line item and send to legal?
sam-engineer: Sending PS template via DM now.
maya-sales: Thanks team — this should clear the enterprise blockers for the demo.
